answer:
**MLflow:** The registry URI is the positional path argument, in the `models:/` form. The tracking server is set through environment variables. The docs show:

"promptfoo scan-model models:/model-name/version" [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md]

"- `MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI`: The URI of your MLflow tracking server." [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md]

"promptfoo scan-model models:/MyModel/1" [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/index.md]

**JFrog Artifactory:** You pass the full URL of the model file as the argument, and the base URL and token come from environment variables:

"- `JFROG_URL`: The base URL of your JFrog Artifactory instance." [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md]

"- `JFROG_API_TOKEN` or `JFROG_ACCESS_TOKEN`: Your API or access token." [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md]

The example command is `promptfoo scan-model "https://your-domain.jfrog.io/artifactory/repo/model.pkl"` [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md].

Note that the JFrog ML provider is a different product. The docs say: "This is different from **JFrog Artifactory**, which is supported in [ModelAudit]" [promptfoo/site/docs/providers/jfrog.md].

The provided context doesn't document a dedicated flag for selecting a registry. As far as I can tell from these excerpts, the URI you pass determines the source.
